lines.text: Your issues are monsters!
lines.el: [shouts] Your issues are MONSTERS!

lines.text: Your AI agents are units!
lines.el: [excited] Your AI agents are UNITS!

lines.text: GBrain is their shared memory!
lines.el: [excited] G Brain is their shared memory!
lines.say: G Brain is their shared memory!

lines.text: River forges new unit types!
lines.el: [excited] River forges NEW unit types!

lines.text: This is QM RAID!
lines.el: [shouts] This is Q M RAID!

lines.text: Hear ye, hear ye! Order a knight, a real QM agent, to a camp.
lines.el: [excited] Hear ye, hear ye! Order a knight, a real Q M agent, to a camp.
lines.say: Hear ye, hear ye! Order a knight, a real Q M agent, to a camp.

lines.text: Blue beam: first it checks the Library, our GBrain. Then it works the issue. For real.
lines.el: Blue beam: first, it checks the Library... our G Brain. Then it works the issue... For real.
lines.say: Blue beam: first it checks the Library, our G Brain. Then it works the issue. For real.

lines.text: Gold orb: what it learned goes back on the shelf.
lines.el: Gold orb: what it learned goes back on the shelf.

lines.anchor: qm_cut (only if the QM view shows the GBrain tool calls)
lines.text: Inside QM, the same knight: the order, its GBrain tool calls, the reply.
lines.el: Inside Q M, the same knight: the order... its G Brain tool calls... the reply.

lines.text: Three units? That's a team. Form the Trio: planner, implementer, reviewer.
lines.el: Three units? [mischievously] That's a team. Form the Trio: planner, implementer, reviewer.

lines.text: Right-click a camp, and the scrolls fly. The reviewer checks the work against the house rules.
lines.el: Right-click a camp... and the scrolls fly! The reviewer checks the work against the house rules.

lines.text: Right-click a camp, and the scrolls fly. The reviewer is a Rule Warden, forged by River.
lines.el: Right-click a camp... and the scrolls fly! The reviewer is a Rule Warden, forged by River.

lines.text: Verdict: approved! The camp falls.
lines.el: [excited] Verdict: APPROVED! The camp falls.

lines.text: Verdict: changes! Back to the anvil, implementer.
lines.el: Verdict: changes! [mischievously] Back to the anvil, implementer.

lines.text: Same trio, inside QM: every handoff is a real conversation.
lines.el: Same trio, inside Q M: every handoff is a real conversation.

lines.text: Need a unit nobody has? To the Forge! River fine-tunes a model on practice orders.
lines.el: Need a unit nobody has? [excited] To the Forge! River fine-tunes a model on practice orders.

lines.text: Refund Ranger, Rule Warden: each beats its base model on held-out test orders.
lines.el: Refund Ranger, Rule Warden: each beats its base model on held-out test orders.

lines.text: Train one, and out it walks!
lines.el: Train one, and out it walks!

lines.text: A new issue? A fresh camp appears on the map.
lines.el: A new issue? A fresh camp appears on the map.

lines.text: Autopilot proposes orders, each with a fifteen second veto ring. Object now, or forever hold your peace.
lines.el: Autopilot proposes orders... each with a fifteen second veto ring. [mischievously] Object now, or forever hold your peace.

lines.text: Don't like one? Cancel it. Like one? Let it ride.
lines.el: Don't like one? Cancel it. Like one? [mischievously] Let it ride.
lines.anchor: veto, only if a cancel is on screen

lines.text: Every knight carries a loadout: standing orders, skills, and plugins.
lines.el: Every knight carries a loadout: standing orders, skills, and plugins.

lines.text: Rewrite its standing orders right here, mid-battle.
lines.el: Rewrite its standing orders right here... mid-battle.

lines.text: One human. Thirty-one AI agents. Built today.
lines.el: One human. Thirty-one AI agents. Built today.

lines.text: One human, a swarm of AI agents, built today.
lines.el: One human, a swarm of AI agents, built today.
